collection.source_semantics: observation-time host samples and log-derived SBI/PFCP

conditions.operation: One existing fixed authenticated read-only NRF discovery GET within the middle window

schedule.grouping: Keep both matched blocks and all their windows in the same pair partition
schedule.failure_policy: Retain every failed block; do not selectively replace failures or silently reuse pair IDs

primary_analysis.measurement: Within-pair difference in middle-window SBI event count, benign_nrf minus passive
primary_analysis.unit: Matched pair, not individual adjacent windows
primary_analysis.causal_limit: No attribution of background PFCP to NRF and no claim of fuzz-triggered anomaly detection

future_model_plan_required: Frozen model and threshold before held-out scoring

execution_prerequisites: Reviewed window-synchronized benign-operation runner (not yet implemented)
Non-secret current AMF NF instance identity
Request start/end receipt and exact request hash
Verify request interval lies inside the middle measured window
Matched collection limits and parser revisions
Independent label/fixture review with evidence references
